deadline.value: Funding consideration requires a complete application by January 15; later applications are considered only if space is available.
deadline.quote: The deadline for consideration for funding is January 15th

fee_waiver.value: The College of Science waives the fee only for its own current PhD students applying to math; it does not waive it otherwise.
fee_waiver.quote: The application fee is waived only if you are currently enrolled in a PhD program in the College of Science | It is the policy of the College of Science not to waive the application fee under any other circumstances

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required as part of the application.
gre_general.quote: The GRE is not required as part of the application for the PhD in Mathematics

gre_subject.value: The GRE is not required as part of the application, including any subject test.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE is not required as part of the application for the PhD in Mathematics

supervisor.value: The FAQ and catalog do not say whether a faculty supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: The department offers a limited number of teaching assistantships and research fellowships.
funding.quote: Financial aid offered by the Mathematics Department is in the form of a limited number of teaching assistantships and research fellowships

entry_route.value: Applicants are expected to hold a recent bachelor's degree in mathematics or equivalent preparation.
entry_route.quote: It is expected that all applicants have a recent bachelor's degree in mathematics or an equivalent amount of undergraduate mathematics preparation

notes: The FAQ says international students should confirm the deadline with the College of Science.
